pages.text: Shallow water, mud and lily pads. Slimes come out at night in swamps, witches have huts here (YUNG's Better Witch Huts), frogs live in the water, and Naturalist's $(bold)alligators$() wait in it. Mangrove swamps grow their trees on roots over the water.$(br2)Mangrove wood needs $(bold)Woodcutting 45$() to chop. See $(l:lemursaucepacket:skills)Skills$(/l).
